body:
Handoff accepted. This baseline assignment remains complete.

- The [v0.2 core reference](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-core-reference) is the bounded knowledge baseline for [website work](/SHE/issues/SHE-3): C1–C13 remain unchanged, with the external/internal Analysis distinction preserved.
- Website drafting must retain illustrative-only scoring, the tied-count/single-lead correction, and the founder’s limitations on all current examples. The synthetic example is an unendorsed archival draft.
- Chief of Staff owns the downstream website draft and prioritization of corrections. This handoff establishes neither comprehension validation nor publication permission. No additional task or hire is needed to close this assignment.

Completed baseline v0.2 with the founder's answered review recorded.

- Updated and verified the [source register](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-source-register), [core reference](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-core-reference), [learning guide](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-learning-guide), and [decision/open-question log](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-open-questions). Original revisions and captured source snapshot remain preserved.
- C1–C13 definitions are unchanged and confirmed as the current baseline bounded to the inspected website; no additional source is required. Scoring is illustrative only; the external/internal Analysis distinction is confirmed.
- Applied the founder's limitation to all current teaching examples: they are not endorsed as entirely useful and may be ignored or loosely referenced. The synthetic worked example remains inspectable as an unendorsed archival draft with explicit assumptions, not an approved teaching application.
- Retained the tied-count/single-lead correction finding. No validation, comprehension result or publication permission is inferred.
- Acceptance is satisfied through the real answered interaction 77867ccc-219e-45fa-bb19-68e122fecdd0: material uncertainty is resolved or explicitly bounded.
- Handoff / next owner: [@Chief of Staff](agent://fdf9690b-d2b7-438d-a0cf-59f0cfd245f2) may use the bounded reference for [website work](/SHE/issues/SHE-3), carrying forward the example and scoring limitations. Chief of Staff owns prioritization of future example refinement and website corrections; no extra task was created. No remaining work on this baseline assignment.

Acknowledged Chief of Staff’s review handoff; founder decisions remain pending.

- Verified existing human-only interaction `77867ccc-219e-45fa-bb19-68e122fecdd0` is pending with `wake_assignee`; retained that card.
- The [core reference](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-core-reference) and [teaching example](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-learning-guide) remain provisional. This coordination comment supplies no founder approval or corrections.
- Next action: founder answers the existing card, coordinated by Chief of Staff; The Oracle then records the decisions and revises the baseline. [Website work](/SHE/issues/SHE-3) retains its knowledge dependency. Acceptance remains outstanding; returning this task to in_review.

Founder review is ready; the existing question card remains pending.

- Start with the [core reference](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-core-reference), then answer the saved **Founder review: MOSAIC baseline v0.1** card: confirm source authority, scoring/Analysis boundaries, and the [synthetic teaching example](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-learning-guide), or supply corrections.
- The Oracle retains ownership. Your card response wakes The Oracle to record the decisions and revise the baseline.
- The baseline remains provisional and [website work](/SHE/issues/SHE-3) retains its knowledge dependency until material uncertainty is resolved or explicitly bounded.

Baseline v0.1 is saved for founder review.

- Delivered the [source register and missing-source inventory](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-source-register), [versioned core reference](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-core-reference), [glossary, worked example and FAQ](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-learning-guide), and [open-question/contradiction log](/SHE/issues/SHE-2#document-open-questions).
- Inspected the [published framework](https://groundstoact.com/framework) and its content modules. Preserved the [dated source snapshot and SHA-256 manifest](/api/attachments/897bd8b1-5f56-423b-bd31-7373e037b391/content).
- Verified saved document revisions and source mappings. The example is explicitly synthetic; no efficacy or comprehension result is claimed.
- Material review findings: illustrative scores versus the framework's score-compression warning; equal signal counts displayed as one lead; the two meanings of Analysis. Suggested corrections are in the core reference.
- Saved pending human-only founder review interaction 77867ccc-219e-45fa-bb19-68e122fecdd0. It covers canonical authority/missing materials, scoring and Analysis boundaries, and the teaching example; its response wakes The Oracle.
- Next owner/action: [@Chief of Staff](agent://fdf9690b-d2b7-438d-a0cf-59f0cfd245f2) coordinates founder answers in that card. The Oracle will record the decision and revise the baseline. [Website work](/SHE/issues/SHE-3) retains its existing knowledge dependency. Acceptance is not yet satisfied, so this task is in_review.
